name: croc_swimming
description: Saltwater crocodile swimming at the surface, facing right: head (eye bump, yellow eye, nostrils, closed jaw line) and back scutes/crest just above the waterline; body and tail below the surface as a darker olive shape with the tail mid-sweep; a small white V wake off the snout and ripple lines. Reads on sea blue #3a9ad9 and olive river water. Anchor centre on the waterline; bbox x -450..462, y -60..90.
